pinyin-pro 3.29.4
Project: https://github.com/zh-lx/pinyin-pro
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pinyin-pro/-/pinyin-pro-3.29.4.tgz
License: MIT; see pinyin-pro.LICENSE.txt.

pinyin-pro.js is the unmodified package/dist/index.js UMD bundle.
The browser API is window.pinyinPro.pinyin(text, { toneType: "none" }).
It supplies offline romanization for optional English metro announcements.
User-provided station.nameEn and line.nameEn take precedence.
